mainEntity.name: How long does insurance-coordinated interior restoration usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the extent of damage, how fast the claim is documented, and how quickly the insurer approves the scope. Smaller interior repairs may move quickly, while larger fire, water, or mold-related projects can take longer because approvals and material lead times often affect the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline depends on damage size, claim approval speed, and material availability. Simple repairs may be quick, while larger projects can take longer if the scope must be reviewed and approved first.
